answer: Each identity pays a 10-unit registration fee per epoch, but the fee multiplies by the number of identities sharing its funding source. One fake costs 10; a cluster of 100 fakes pays 1,000 each, so total cost scales quadratically. The funding graph is public, so a sybil farm shows up like a canyon, one deep channel feeding a hundred mouths, and any identity that skips payment is suspended at once. No zephyr of discretion, and the echo of identical funding convicts the cluster.
